G.19.finding: The Board states releases occur around the fifth business day but does not publish exact dates for the full horizon; exact dates remain BLOCKED until announced.

H.8.finding: The Board states H.8 is released Friday at 4:15 p.m. ET, or Thursday when Friday is a federal holiday; rule-derived dates are labeled EXPECTED_RULE.

NY Fed HHDC.finding: The calendar announces August 4 and November 3, 2026 without a release time; those date-only events and later unannounced quarters remain BLOCKED rather than assigned inferred timestamps.

Census MARTS.finding: Exact 8:30 a.m. ET dates are announced through December 2026; later months remain BLOCKED.

BEA Personal Income and Outlays.finding: Exact 8:30 a.m. ET dates are announced through December 2026; later months remain BLOCKED.
